jobs.occupation: Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

At Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly-skilled Tax director, specialized in German and Swiss tax, then get ready to join our company.

This role will report to the Group Head of Tax.

Day-to-day responsibilities

As a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.
- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.
- Take ownership of tax processes at Group level for the Tax Cluster area and ensure coordination between local teams, Group Finance, and external advisors (including transfer pricing documentation, foreign tax credits, local incentives, and subsidies)
- Provide advice and support to group tax team, finance, legal and operational teams on  tax matters including CIT, VAT, and country-specific taxes and compliance requirements. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required
- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).
- Anticipate and assess tax risks across the Tax cluster perimeter, considering local regulatory changes and multi-country implications and work closely with group tax team in this respect. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.
- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.

This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.

- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).
- Professional proficiency of English and German is required
- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)
- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.
- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. 
- You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.
- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide
- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career
- An exciting salary
- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career
- And many more...

#LI-AB1

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

PhD in Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Plant Science, Data Science or a related discipline.

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Join our collaborative EMEA Instrument and Enterprise Service Quality team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to global healthcare, research, and safety. As a Supplier Quality Engineer III, you'll ensure the quality and reliability of our supply chain and support Quality Management System processes while contributing to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

In this role, you'll manage supplier qualification processes, schedule and conduct comprehensive audits, and implement continuous improvement initiatives. You'll work with cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues, implement corrective actions, and maintain strong supplier and quality relationships.

Your expertise will be essential in developing and maintaining supplier/vendor quality metrics, managing quality agreements, and ensuring compliance and quality with industry standards and regulations.

Manage supplier performance, guide quality improvement projects, and contribute to new product introductions. You'll have the opportunity to support team development while working with a global network of professionals dedicated to excellence in quality management.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Master Thesis - Exploration of the Domain of Validity for Multiaxial Fatigue Analysis Criteria

Location: Hamburg (Finkenwerder / ZAL)

Start Date: 01.09.2026

Duration: 6 months

About Us

Are you looking to bridge the gap between academic research and cutting-edge industrial application? Airbus Operations is seeking a motivated Master’s student (d/f/m) to join our R&T NSDW Integration team. You will be fully embedded within a transnational Research & Technology (R&T) team of Structural Analysis specialists working on the Next Generation Aircraft.

Your Work Environment & Benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.
- We treat you as a full-fledged team member. You will participate in weekly team meetings, collaborate with various engineering interfaces, and network globally.
- Gain hands-on experience with modern, diversified technologies and state-of-the-art simulation tools.

You will work at Airbus' largest civil aircraft production site in Hamburg Finkenwerder. Enjoy a unique workplace on the banks of the river Elbe, with the option to commute by ferry and experience Hamburg's vibrant maritime culture.

The Challenge (Thesis Background)

While analytical approaches for fatigue calculation guarantee a minimum fatigue life and work excellently for simple analytical sizing and generic metallic structures, there is significant room for optimization in complex structures. In this regard, Airbus is actively studying methods to evaluate multiaxial stress fields via modern 3D finite element analysis. Your thesis will contribute to validating these new approaches for integration into future Airbus fatigue assessment methods.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

During your 6-month thesis, you will:

- Evaluate fatigue criteria tailored to detailed, high-fidelity simulations.
- Utilize Python to process complex simulation data and evaluate the limits/domains of validity for new methods.
- Work closely with the structural analysis team and document your findings for potential integration into future industrial sizing methods.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

- Enrolled full-time Master’s student (d/f/m) in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Mechanics, or a similar field of study.
- Sound basic knowledge of overall aircraft design and strong foundational skills in Finite Element Modeling (FEM).
- High proficiency in Python for data processing, scripting, and automation.
- Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work autonomously within a research-driven environment.
- Proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

jobs.occupation: Verantwortliche Elektrofachkraft Offshore-Windkraftanlagen (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Windenergietechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you play a key role in ensuring electrical safety across our offshore substations and wind turbines while helping us push the boundaries of safe, efficient, and reliable offshore operations.

Join us in this role where you’ll take independent ownership of electrical safety within your area of responsibility, overseeing electrical installations on wind turbines in our German wind farms. You’ll combine your deep technical expertise with on-site presence—both at your permanent base in Norddeich and offshore—in order to guide colleagues, strengthen procedures, and ensure safe systems of work.

Welcome to HV and Transmission GER

You’ll be part of HV and Transmission GER, where you and your colleagues will ensure electrical safety governance and operational support across high-voltage infrastructure in our German offshore wind farms. Your team is dedicated to managing safety-critical systems, uplifting operational standards, and sharing expertise across the organisation.

As a team, we collaborate closely, support one another’s development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.

You’ll play an important role in:

- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work
- supporting the selection, training, and supervision of Authorised Persons, electricians, and electrically instructed persons offshore
- contributing to the qualification and supervision of contractors in the offshore electrical environment
- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations
- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities
- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training
- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)
- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor
- auditing work processes before offshore deployment.

To succeed in the role, you:

- have completed a degree within electrical engineering, or equivalent
- bring strong expertise within electrical safety, including standards, laws, and regulations
- demonstrate technical leadership competence
- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV
- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher
- are comfortable using IT systems, including Microsoft Office, SAP, and AI tools
- ideally have a qualification for live working, experience with wind turbines, or prior responsibility as an electrician
- meet the minimum competency requirements within your onboarding timeframe, supported by our learning and development processes.

**Country-specific requirements: **fulfil the requirements of a responsible electrician (vEFK) according to VDE 1000-10.

Please note that in this role you will be mainly working in our office in Norddeich from Monday to Friday. An important part of the role will be an inspection of plants and the professional guidance of the electricians. This requires partial work offshore (20-40%) in a 7- or 14-day shift pattern.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us
Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.
